display.purpose: Overview-mode match titles and the primary editorial subject.

headline.purpose: Focused match titles when the report is reviewing one candidate.

title.purpose: The report identity inside the navigation rail.

body.purpose: Short operational descriptions and supporting review copy.

label.purpose: Mono kickers, scope labels, IDs, dimensions, keyboard hints, and controls.

motion.name: editorial-ease
motion.purpose: Controlled movement for navigation, controls, progress, and review transitions.

motion.name: editorial-duration
motion.purpose: Default slow transition that makes state changes legible without feeling playful.

breakpoints.name: rail-collapse

breakpoints.name: compact

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Paper-on-ink action for opening the pin or original image.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #f2f0eb; border-radius: 0; background: #f2f0eb; color: #080808; font: 700 11px/16px Geist Mono, ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 700ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), background 700ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), color 700ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), transform 700ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1); } .ds-primary-action:hover { border-color: #ff3b30; background: #ff3b30; color: #fff; } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff3b30; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary-action:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Quiet surface action that keeps the report chrome present but secondary.
components.css: .ds-secondary-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #494949; border-radius: 0; background: #111; color: #c3c0b9; font: 700 11px/16px Geist Mono, ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 700ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), background 700ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), color 700ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), transform 700ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1); } .ds-secondary-action:hover { border-color: #ff3b30; background: #202020; color: #f2f0eb; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-secondary-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff3b30; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-secondary-action:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Review Action
components.description: Large paper action for marking the current evidence frame reviewed.
components.css: .ds-review-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid #f2f0eb; border-radius: 0; background: #f2f0eb; color: #080808; font: 700 11px/16px Geist Mono, ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 700ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), background 700ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), color 700ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1); } .ds-review-action:hover, .ds-review-action[aria-pressed='true'] { border-color: #ff3b30; background: #ff3b30; color: #fff; } .ds-review-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff3b30; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-review-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-review-action kbd { min-width: 18px; padding: 2px 4px; border: 1px solid #494949; border-radius: 0; background: #080808; color: #c3c0b9; font: 600 12px/16px Geist Mono, ui-monospace, monospace; text-align: center; }

components.name: Scope Filter
components.description: Square segmented filter for all, same-board, and cross-board matches.
components.css: .ds-scope-filter { display: flex; gap: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #393939; } .ds-scope-filter button { flex: 1; min-height: 44px; padding: 14px 4px; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid #393939; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #898783; font: 700 12px/16px Geist Mono, ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background 700ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), color 700ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), outline 700ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1); } .ds-scope-filter button:hover { color: #f2f0eb; background: #111; } .ds-scope-filter button[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #ff3b30; color: #fff; } .ds-scope-filter button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff3b30; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Match Navigation Item
components.description: Border-separated evidence index row for moving through matches.
components.css: .ds-match-nav-item { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 40px minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap: 12px; align-items: center; width: 100%; padding: 18px 20px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #292929; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #c3c0b9; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 700ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), color 700ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1), padding 700ms cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1); } .ds-match-nav-item:hover { padding-left: 26px; color: #f2f0eb; } .ds-match-nav-item[aria-current='true'] { background: #f2f0eb; color: #080808; } .ds-match-index { color: #898783; font: 700 10px/16px Geist Mono, ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-match-nav-item[aria-current='true'] .ds-match-index { color: #ff3b30; } .ds-match-copy { min-width: 0; } .ds-match-copy strong, .ds-match-copy small { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-match-copy strong { font: 600 14px/20px Geist, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-match-copy small { margin-top: 4px; color: #898783; font: 400 12px/16px Geist Mono, ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-match-nav-item[aria-current='true'] .ds-match-copy small { color: #555; } .ds-scope-mark { width: 7px; height: 7px; background: #ff3b30; } .ds-match-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff3b30; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.description: Compact mono marker for recommendation and board-scope states.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 4px 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: #181818; color: #c3c0b9; font: 700 12px/16px Geist Mono, ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-badge--signal { color: #ff3b30; } .ds-status-badge--paper { color: #f2f0eb; }

narrative.overview:
The report is a cinematic, severe workspace for looking closely before acting. It uses a full-bleed ink field, a dark editorial rail, and oversized compressed headlines to make each comparison feel like a piece of evidence brought forward for inspection. The page is intentionally spare: the images, dimensions, board context, and review state carry the visual weight.

The final effective system is the Editorial review system defined at the end of templates/report.html. Its square silhouettes, hairline seams, paper-white selections, and signal-red state changes are authoritative. The earlier rounded workspace preset in the same file is an implementation ancestor, not a direction to revive. Motion is slow and controlled, helping the user move through a sequence of matches without making the review feel playful.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed ink-black canvas with a nearly black rail and chrome.
Severe editorial typography: oversized, tightly tracked Geist headlines paired with compact Geist Mono labels.
Paper-white primary and selected states; signal red reserved for status, focus, and review signals.
Square controls and comparison frames joined by one-pixel seams rather than soft elevation.
Image-first comparison surfaces with restrained interaction and explicit review state.

rules.name: The Signal Red Rule
rules.body: Red is a status instrument, not a decorative accent: reserve it for focus, active filters, review states, progress, and editorial markers.

rules.name: The Paper-on-Ink Rule
rules.body: Use paper as the decisive selected or primary state against the ink field; do not dilute it into a general-purpose surface fill.

rules.name: The Compression Rule
rules.body: Large headings should feel cut from one editorial block: tight tracking and short line-height create authority without adding ornament.

rules.name: The Mono Evidence Rule
rules.body: Put IDs, dimensions, percentages, keyboard hints, and other inspectable values in Geist Mono so evidence reads differently from explanation.

rules.name: The Flat-Seam Rule
rules.body: If a surface can be separated with a tonal change or one-pixel rule, do that before adding a shadow.

dos: Do keep the visual hierarchy severe: large compressed titles, short descriptions, and images before decoration.
Do use signal red only where the user needs to notice a state, not as a general brand wash.
Do use paper-on-ink for primary and selected states.
Do preserve square silhouettes and one-pixel seams across controls, navigation, filters, and comparison frames.
Do use Geist Mono for inspectable data and keep focus-visible outlines explicit.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion by collapsing transitions to near-zero duration.
donts: Don't reintroduce the earlier rounded-card, pill, or ambient-shadow preset into the final editorial system.
Don't add decorative gradients, glows, image filters, or parallax to the comparison surface.
Don't make every control red; red is a signal and loses meaning when it becomes a background theme.
Don't let supporting copy compete with the images or the match heading.
Don't hide keyboard focus behind the cinematic treatment.
